section-testimonials-quote-1: I started from zero and now follow the beat with confidence. Classes are super fun!
section-testimonials-quote-2: Improved my coordination fast and met awesome people.

section-classes-paragraph: We're preparing group and private classes.
section-faq-question-1: Do I need any dance experience?
section-faq-answer-1: Not at all! Our classes are built so anyone can learn from zero.
section-faq-question-2: What should I wear to class?
section-faq-answer-2: Just bring comfortable clothes and sneakers.
section-faq-answer-3: Every class lasts about 60 minutes of pure fun.
section-faq-question-4: How many people are in each class?
section-faq-answer-4: We keep groups small (8–12) for personal attention.
section-faq-question-5: Can I join if I'm not flexible yet?
section-faq-answer-5: Yes! Breakdance is all about progress, not perfection.
section-faq-answer-6: Yes, we offer private 1-on-1 lessons and event performances.
section-footer-paragraph: Bringing the energy of breakdance to Madrid.
